campaign: Integrated validation, phase 2: bounded capability gains and evidence-gated simplification
doctrine: Priority: improve robustness and cut gate, automation and runtime wall time and peak memory by consolidating duplicated logic into fewer general components, never by adding instrumentation or a framework. Net AST nodes stay flat or fall: every addition deletes at least as much, a new general component replaces the copies it subsumes, and the clone and harness ratchets hold the floor. Do safe, behavior-preserving consolidations first, the ones existing tests and the ratchets already cover; take deeper execution-core and command-surface simplification behind the model-regression baseline so a removal never loses proven behavior. Preserve the capability freeze enforced by structure: no new model family, workflow, optimizer or orchestration framework. Preserve acceptance and independent model progress; these priorities add no automation prerequisite to model validation. Document order ranks ready work; depends_on names actual producers. A step's machine check is its verify, set with plan -setverify; a check whose real prerequisite cannot run records UNAVAILABLE rather than a pass. GUI and audio retain their lanes. Master execution proceeds under role master-lead. docs/plan.json is the sole live plan.

items.title: Reduce recurring build and gate cost, then simplify dispatch and publication

steps.title: Show a concise actionable contract and retain history by reference
steps.verify: test -f internal/plan/workflow_contract_test.go && go test ./internal/plan -run '^TestDispatchContractBinding$' -count=1 && test -f cmd/plan/workflow_contract_test.go && go test ./cmd/plan -run '^TestPromptContractProjection$' -count=1
steps.rationale:
Extend the existing Step/AutomationContext schema with a bounded actionable contract and separate history/evidence references. Render the contract with the title, exact verifier, prerequisites, scope, frozen acceptance and stop conditions in prompt/context. Keep history available by explicit reference or history request, outside the normal task prompt. Do not heuristically truncate rationale and discard constraints. Migrate touched rows explicitly, preserving old schema readers or declaring a tested version transition, semantic merge and completion-authority binding. Contract changes invalidate dependent dispatch/acceptance; history-only edits do not authorize new work or erase obligations. Acceptance covers a constraint previously buried after a long rationale, legacy row migration, history omission from normal prompt, explicit history retrieval, contract tampering, and no duplicated operational state. Start with call-reach and publication rows; a whole-plan prose rewrite is not required.

Include claimant, execution mode, stop and readiness state plus a usable cmd/finding invocation from the shared command metadata. Do not hard-code a second usage signature in the prompt.

steps.title: Replace doctrine substring gates with semantic contract checks
steps.rationale:
The current campaign tests pin phrases including capability freeze enforced by structure, UNAVAILABLE and plan -setverify. Replace correctness assertions about prose with the owning typed policy/plan structure and behavior they were intended to protect. Reuse existing capability/admission/completion contracts; introduce the smallest typed declaration only for a real policy input not already represented. Do not copy all doctrine prose into JSON booleans or a parallel policy registry. Preserve independent negative tests: forbidden capability expansion, missing executable acceptance, unsupported outcome credited as success and invalid dependency/completion must still fail.

Acceptance changes wording without changing policy and passes; changes a protected semantic invariant while retaining every old phrase and fails. Update the affected validation and GUI campaign tests at their existing owner, retaining genuine lane/contract requirements. During migration any remaining literal pin is enumerated by source/test and surfaced by edit validation rather than discovered after expensive checks. A prettier string matcher is transitional, not completion. Policy/schema changes receive affected critical tests immediately; ordinary future prose edits must not trigger model suites.

Normalize verification into existing typed check IDs and batch checkpoint obligations as part of this owner's semantic validation. Resolve argv, package, selector, fixture prerequisites and input/environment binding once; preserve legacy verify syntax until callers migrate atomically. Do not add a second manifest/registry or a wrapper command around duplicated lists. A nonexistent guarded test is explicitly unimplemented and cannot close; an existing shared file with a missing test name or skipped assertion also cannot close. Preserve all independently required assertions when consolidating measured-adoption, common-owner-pilot and recipe-node-reuse; deduplicate only exact obligation identities, not different tests covering similar lines. Acceptance covers absent files, zero-match patterns, missing member assertions, conflicting check definitions and repeated references reusing original result provenance. The standard-library pilots and cheap preflight do not wait for this representation migration.

Closure-admission case after b0ce384b: plan -edit accepted a new open step outside campaign-closeout's transitive prerequisites; preflight's TestOptimizedValidationCampaign caught it later. Move the applicable closeout-coverage invariant into the existing semantic plan owner used by edit/Save and tests. An insertion or dependency edit must either preserve coverage or refuse before publication with the missing reference. Preserve other campaigns' contracts; do not duplicate policy in the CLI or silently invent dependencies.

steps.title: Project command purpose, audience and flags into the API manifest
steps.rationale: Extend existing command metadata, clioptions and apimanifest owners. The Binary schema already has flags but lacks purpose/audience; populate the existing projection from the execution FlagSet and minimal owner-declared purpose/audience metadata, including flag descriptions and relevant operation constraints. Help and JSON share that declaration; no hand-maintained parallel flag registry. Classify operator-facing, automation-internal or both by actual callers and contracts, not name suffixes. Derive the shipped binary denominator from the build/release inventory rather than hard-code 102. Bind build context and flag registration; test added/removed/renamed flags, defaults, descriptions, conditional registrations and missing classifications. Metadata inspection must not execute workloads or arbitrary command init side effects. Unknown conditional flags remain explicitly unresolved until bound; do not advertise an incomplete command as complete. Start with plan and overgodb-query; roll remaining commands into existing command-surface consolidation by owner. Preserve manifest compatibility and existing consumers. Classification improves discovery and identifies removal candidates; it alone proves no API or binary consolidation.

steps.title: Expose and verify the existing scratch-module workflow
steps.rationale: Owner: cmd/plan developer workflow; no new responsibility in cmd/preflight and no new probe runner. Current tmp/go.mod declares module overgo/tmp, requires overgo and replaces it with ..; a named Go file importing overgo/internal/plan runs without an overlay from either repository root or tmp. This session verified both commands: from root go run ./tmp/plan_import_discovery_probe.go, and from tmp go run ./plan_import_discovery_probe.go. Expose the same supported invocation and active module/root resolution in existing cmd/plan developer-workflow help/diagnostics, with a small reproducible example; do not add a probe executable, overlay wrapper or another module mechanism. Acceptance generates an isolated temporary fixture with the same parent/nested module contract, proves internal import legality from both working directories, and proves scratch packages remain outside the production ./... package set. Mark exploratory outputs as diagnostic, with exact source identity; publishing acceptance still uses declared tracked tests and immutable candidate sources. Existing developer guidance may reference the command; no generated Markdown instructions or stray handoff files.

items.title: Declare the denominator and validate existing modality capabilities

steps.title: Resume one media acquisition through idempotent publication
steps.rationale:
Implement one bounded media acquisition-to-report slice through existing run-record, execution, candidate and compatibility owners. The typed protocol binds inputs, source/overlay, model/data identities, frozen assertions, units, budget and publication outputs. Discover completed acquisitions before loading a model; checkpoint each cell and make evidence/report publication idempotent. Force restart before and after acquisition, record commit and projection publication; recover the unfinished transition with no duplicate model load or mutation. Include rejected candidates, duplicate observations, exact result reuse, budget exhaustion and missing-resource waits with explicit resumption triggers. Measure total elapsed/compute/loading/verification/recovery/intervention cost against the current same-task workflow. Keep output generation in existing compatibility owners and migrate the concrete temporary publishers this slice replaces. Split at the first owning boundary if implementation cannot fit one bounded batch; no new general experiment framework and no prerequisite on the whole modality campaign.

First concrete reuse target: Qwen27 exact projection at d2b6484a. The complete 20-case run took 85.0753809s including 20.9611281s evaluation; evaluator replay took 1.5085ms, zero generation and zero writes. Recipe verification still prepares/opens the model before this reuse check. Move discovery before model acquisition through the existing exact plan/ledger owner, preserving full artifact/source/environment/protocol binding and both retained success and failure. Reuse the acquisition and read-only acceptance from qwen27-projection; do not reacquire it to benchmark a scheduler. Attribute store/identity/model-load startup separately before further caching. Split this first boundary from broader experiment orchestration if necessary.

First acquisition boundary is split into exact-replay-before-open. Continue the remaining publication/restart workflow through existing internal/loop and execution owners, not a new internal/agentloop package. Retain publication idempotency, rejected candidates, duplicate observations, budgets and resumption triggers here; the child does not complete these obligations.

steps.title: Complete outstanding text performance evidence independently of modality validation
steps.rationale:
Retain accepted functional evidence for unchanged execution dependencies. Do not require E4B performance readmission before progressing other models or independent modality rows. Preserve E4B's completed quality/protocol/resource evidence and performance finding evidence:sha256:403bfd8bd2a023ffcace7f8d036a5cf1736409210555d7990d3a2acb4c7ec3bd. Record evidence:sha256:3563a7f4941d6051ae67167c7e1d58726472a6582109159644b70378c952a2f8 missed decode floors; diagnostic evidence:sha256:6074d0903b6363ac97e86d11f6e5679c2c9c0ed4e8bc04766705ffa9a2144d27 did not establish cause. No new E4B run solely to obtain a passing speed. A future diagnostic must distinguish a quantified mechanism; missing historical telemetry cannot be reconstructed by favorable reruns.

This row closes only with the existing full performance-catalog assertion: eight live models, retained retired history, matching immutable identities and protocols, complete required cohorts and unchanged quality/rate/resource bounds. Functional acceptance and performance acceptance are separate claims. Reuse unaffected evidence; never relabel a failed speed result as accepted.

History evidence:sha256:f2066497888061234f5dbe53aaa36aac08e8006f40c933d88e3e851b42c1611e preserves both 43a2c7aa and 2ef953fa selections and all 49 referenced records/findings. Bind it before replacing guard-catalog.json; retain the producer experiment and retired MiniCPM. Compare corrected MiniCPM only against its own accepted 2ef953fa identity. Historical tests bind their historical surface and grant no current-model credit.

Keep latency findings 7ff7c0b6406545604fa20777966f7baf30e043b66ebf92180f1043c6fb1c2d92 and b5d8dbb56cbad0ef0ba10abb2a72f2bb5cc5e6d3821d3add4a2c846e991dddf9 separate from clock finding 0efdd1e7844ddb6900e97d6fbb9b76ef554b3f0ea3aae878ca90a92a1a9bc04c. Close MiniCPM identity 8584276e4b1e44ebcbfc7ac0886b097720049eaddc0c681587bf2f903db1cf28 and decode-order 5f3f75ea0d8cf6727bc79e9f4c054d7242e2f0b81ae17a8fa454065158c216ee only after their full readmission. Scheduling finding e8c0bcf9fd76671c85d9707e4d5da908dc7bd24b3a71734ca9c7887f115e87df stays Hatchet-owned. No unrelated implementation or lane merge during acquisition.

Dispatch review at a37a6119: the opted-in assertion refuses immediately on the retained pending Qwen incident; no model executes. The source digest is now 0e9d9c8b53df7271a5cab6f9fe4897957325a610dde801b693e419a980c6d10e, while refreshed Qwen/E4B controls bind c256ae3a and the other retained cohorts bind older producers. Preserve every measurement and existing floor. This row follows independent modality and experiment-reuse work; it must not recapture all models merely to refresh a broad digest. Before new acquisition, identify changed reachable execution/measurement code and a discriminating causal hypothesis. The historical 14.054ms Qwen prefill versus roughly 8.98ms controls remains unattributed; unchanged work counts and later passing repeats do not prove either an implementation regression or environmental cause. Missing historical traces cannot be recovered by new repeats. Keep the finding explicit and resume its diagnostic when an affected execution change or a captured slow interval supplies new evidence. Store acceptance is explicitly enabled so this bound verifier cannot silently skip.

steps.title: Choose media execution from measured request capacity
steps.rationale: Start with SenseNova reported approximately 33 GB cumulative Go allocations per request; distinguish allocation traffic from retained and peak host RAM. Attribute costs to actual loader/prefix/denoise/decode code before choosing one bounded fix. Use existing resource admission and recipe owners to derive whole-request RAM/VRAM demand, concurrency and residency from declared geometry and measured phase demand. Preserve requested output, native equality, cancellation/recovery and explicit acceptance. Do not silently reduce resolution/steps or invent an arbitrary memory ceiling. Correctness shares available capacity; performance comparison records competing load and uses isolation only when its protocol requires it. Acceptance covers sufficient/insufficient capacity, a second GPU process, cancellation/release and exact subsequent reuse; report peak/retained RAM and VRAM, allocation traffic and full request cost. Coordinate lane ownership; adopt only a measured net improvement.

items.title: Reuse immutable evidence without copying every small file

steps.title: Measure and decide whether to pack small immutable records
steps.rationale:
The current evidence descriptor census includes 68385 text/plain records totaling 10801019 bytes, 27609 closure-ledger records totaling 29217663 bytes, and 1070 code-manifest-analysis records totaling 1110797445 bytes. Descriptor counts include retained content not necessarily stored as separate blobs; keep physical and logical denominators separate. Compare the retained layout plus snapshot reuse against append-only packs for small immutable records with hash-indexed offsets and separate large payloads. Reuse the existing OvergoDB segment/index owners. Measure publication, reopen, random lookup, backup and concurrent-writer costs with actual size distributions. A retained-layout decision may close this row with evidence and a reopen trigger; packing is not mandatory. If adopted, prove torn-write and crash recovery, per-record integrity, safe index rebuild, source-independent backup, old-store readability and reversible migration before promotion. Preserve immutable IDs and referenced history. Derive packing boundaries from measurements, never an arbitrary file-count target. Reuse source-bound manifest analysis and package receipts; compact physical storage without suppressing distinct failures or obligations.

The 99cdcd8d audio intake uses cmd/plan.captureClosureEvidence -> Store.Backup before closure import. Its first snapshot copies the entire source store although master consumes only a subset of incoming closure evidence. Measure copied versus imported bytes, file count, durable flush cost and source writer hold time. Prefer an exact bounded closure export through existing artifact/backup owners when it preserves content hashes, lineage, a stable source coordinate and replay-verified completion authority. Reuse an already sealed matching snapshot or unchanged blobs; do not add another full-store snapshot per retry. Prove interrupted publication, concurrent source writes, changed-head invalidation and missing-reference refusal. Keep source history intact and make compaction/layout adoption conditional on measured space, replay and merge-preparation savings.

Observed during Qwen4 acquisition preparation on 2026-09-12: a concurrent plan -prepare-merge master held the canonical overgodb.lock while Backup copied immutable blobs. The acquisition publisher queued for about seven minutes before GPU loading. Windows resource-owner inspection identified the merge process and waiting collector; the merge process continued file I/O, so this was live contention, not an abandoned lock. Include source-lock hold time and blocked publication in the layout/backup comparison. Review backup.go lifetime: capture the required journal boundary and immutable blob set under existing ownership, then assess whether copying can safely release writer exclusion while preserving rotation, retention, crash and ancestry contracts. Do not add another lock owner or make this repair a prerequisite of model acquisition.

Merge intake currently snapshots the lane store before copying required closure records. Measure that physical copy and validation cost; reuse immutable content and capture only required closure/active extents through existing backup/import owners before considering a new layout. Preserve the landed metadata-capture/blob-copy writer release; extend its concurrent publication and restart proof only for changed behavior. Do not keep full duplicate snapshots or copy large model payloads merely to transport a few evidence records.

Colibri intake 25889dac provides a measured case: prepare-merge copied and synced 3151745076 bytes in 112057 files, reused none, and took 16m23.0752643s before importing 6869 closure documents with zero unmatched references. Captured store d5a2efd0e4c724bd8da3b2ea8684c11488ef91af617f8449acaf2e4f9d304df5 at sequence 40006. Compare required closure export with full snapshot transport through existing owners; preserve the captured coordinate, hashes, ancestry, restart and concurrent publication contracts. This is evidence-transfer cost, separate from the 24m22.128s integration gate.

Memory is part of acceptance: stream copied records and manifests, avoid simultaneous full source/target inventories or duplicate result blobs, and measure peak live bytes plus allocation volume. Prefer removing redundant copies/scans before changing the physical format. Use the retained 964838b7 snapshot measurements from merge-portability and the shared gate-resource-efficiency accounting; do not repeat those acquisitions solely for a fresh report.

items.title: Stabilize evidence commits; defer broader control policy until model evidence

steps.title: Certify the complete evidence workflow across producer and supervisor crashes
steps.verify: go test ./internal/gate -run '^(TestBatchEvidencePublicationFailure|TestTerminalEvidenceRestart|TestRecoverInterruptedStateCrashRetryBoundaries|TestAbandonedGateAdmission)$' -count=1 && test -f internal/gate/evidence_commit_recovery_test.go && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestEvidenceCommitRecoveryAcceptance$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/overgodb -run '^(TestOpenContextWriterAdmission|TestTransactionWriter|TestSecondWriterFailsClosed)$' -count=1 && test -f internal/gate/evidence_commit_workflow_test.go && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestEvidenceCommitWorkflow$' -count=1
steps.rationale:
Certify the complete producer-to-commit workflow using retained captures and counted acquisition stubs, independently of the full modality report. store-lifetime and admission-recovery own the reproduced handle, startup and recording failures; reuse their implementation and tests. Their synthetic receipt and committed-transaction fixtures do not complete this broader acceptance. No new global prerequisite for model validation.

Use an isolated repository/store, counted acquisition stubs and immutable captures. Inject writer contention before receipt publication, kill before/after persistence, supervisor restart, and interruption between Git commit and final store recording. Completed durable acquisitions must not repeat; interrupted work without a durable result gets no completion credit, and necessary re-execution remains visible in cost. Resume exact unaffected receipts, execute every outstanding required check before promotion, reconcile matching debt, and prove one accepted commit, one plan advance and one final record. Preserve attempts/obligations across restart without manual reconstruction or waiting for a status prompt. Use OS release events; preserve caller cancellation and any explicitly declared overall budget without resetting it on retry.

Refuse changed candidate inputs, invalid receipt reuse across environments, foreign live ownership and corrupt or mismatched authority without destructive changes. Historical finalization retains its original verified environment and may publish without new acquisition; it cannot accept changed current work. Keep existing parity, persistence, interrupted-state and terminal-evidence checks as lower bounds. Do not retry semantic/measurement failure into a pass.

Map existing admission, supervision, publication, retry and finalization callers before editing. Consolidate displaced wrappers/policy with their callers through gate, driver/loop, processcontrol, runrecord and OvergoDB; no new command, daemon, scheduler, receipt schema or forwarding facade. Report exact real/synthetic case counts, acquisitions/reloads, executed/reused checks, outstanding obligations, commit/finalization counts, operator interventions and queue/execution/finalization wall. Compare the same incident inputs and retain failed attempts. Split only at a concrete failure boundary; this parent stays open until the full workflow proof passes.

Merged hybridtrain.TrainingOptions now preserves optimizer momentum and absolute step across host, streamed and resident segments. Reuse that owner if a bounded training experiment needs interruption support; TestHybridOptimizerResumeHost, TestHybridOptimizerResumeDevice, TestHybridOptimizerStopHost, TestHybridResumeRefusals and TestHybridTrainingBoundaryFailures are existing lower bounds. Bind model weights, optimizer state, recipe, dataset position, RNG and backend together before claiming durable training recovery. In-memory optimizer resume alone is not a restart-safe experiment checkpoint. Do not build a second checkpoint format or runner to add that binding.

Land reusable crash/recovery protection early for subsequent evidence publications. Acceptance still covers the complete declared workflow; no synthetic result closes model-quality coverage. Broad batch promotion retains its modality-report prerequisite. Count saved repeat acquisitions and interventions against the accepted recovery implementation, and keep final campaign integration obligations explicit.

steps.title: Promote batching only after recovery, safe selection and measured payback
steps.verify: go test ./internal/gate -run '^(TestPreflightReportsValidateFindings|TestPreflightSeparatesSkippedChecks|TestPreflightNeverRepairsStore|TestPreflightRejectsCombinedInspection|TestGateStartIndexAdoptsStatRefreshUnderSameTree|TestGateStartIndexRefusesAndPreservesLaterUnplannedStaging)$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^(TestCheckpointPersistenceSurvivesKill|TestCheckpointMemoCoversEveryCommand|TestChangeSelectiveVerificationShadow|TestBatchedGateCostEvidence)$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^(TestIndependentPackageEvidenceAcceptance|TestGovernedBatchDeclarationAcceptance|TestProjectedMergePreflightBeforeVerification|TestGateReusesUnchangedCheckEvidence|TestPackageSelectiveReuse)$' -count=1 && test -f internal/gate/batch_promotion_test.go && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestBatchPromotionControl$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestReusedCheckpointCompletionAuthorityAcceptance$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/repoanalysis -run '^(TestDocsHoldNoUnplannedBinaries|TestDocsInventoryPolicy)$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestPreflightRejectsUnplannedDocsBeforeStore$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestChangeSelectionUnownedRuntimeInputs$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/plan -run '^TestBatchFlush' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestCandidateGoPhasesExcludeIgnoredSource$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestBatchEvidence' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^(TestChangedPackageFailurePreventsBroadSweep|TestModernGoPreflightBindsCandidateCensus|TestStaticFailurePreventsAcceptance|TestGateRunsStaticChecksBeforeAcceptance|TestCheckpointEvidenceReuseAcrossRuns|TestPackageSelectiveReuse|TestTerminalEvidenceRestart)$' -count=1
steps.rationale:
Existing checkpoint memo, independent package receipts, transaction recovery, shared GPU admission, input preflight, candidate isolation and terminal-obligation owners are lower bounds, not features to rebuild. Retain every existing verifier, checkpoint and escalation obligation. The new evidence-commit-recovery prerequisite owns immediate reliability repair; this row owns later policy integration. Campaign-wide batch promotion retains its recovery and modality-report prerequisites. Independently proven input selection and correctness-evidence reuse may land through validation-gate-selection/measured-adoption before that report, with the same required outcomes and outstanding obligations. Do not make the completed modality campaign a prerequisite for reducing the verified cost of completing it.

Selection must follow actual compiled dependencies, fixtures, runtime files, subprocesses, renames/deletions, build tags, toolchain, device mode and resolved environment. Unknown reach broadens verification, including required fixture/device tests; it does not justify a short-only downgrade. Before adopting Hatchet classification, add counterexamples for os.Args[1], reassignment and shadowing, aliased os/exec imports, caller-supplied paths, indirect launchers, command argument construction, embedded inputs and repository-level fixtures. Use binding-aware analysis or conservative fallback; textual identifier names, one safe assignment, file extensions and package-wide caller annotations cannot establish independence. Shadow-compare the complete historical/injected-failure matrix against the current full gate: no omitted required checks, missed seeded regression or stale receipt. Policy changes cannot validate themselves using their proposed reduced scope.

Persist each terminal package success independently as it finishes, even if a sibling fails, skips or is killed. Reuse requires exact input/environment/contract identities; a failed write retries receipt publication, not acquisition. Retain cumulative obligations across kill/restart, replan, scope expansion and branch changes. Never credit skipped, unavailable, unfinished or zero-match tests; acquire required fixtures and distinguish explicit unsupported-platform exclusions. Scratch retry files remain projections of OvergoDB authority. Include interrupted replacement of gate_cache.json and independent successful packages beside failed/unavailable siblings.

Prepare mechanical derived authorities before freezing the candidate, then run cheap deterministic refusals before expensive acceptance and packages. Bind both baseline and published census to the staged candidate. Preserve the same resolved dataset roots between acceptance and package tests. Mechanical preparation may regenerate manifests/censuses from existing reviewed policy; it cannot change semantic literal exceptions, floors or adjudication. Recompute candidate identity after preparation; reject later drift. Keep preflight read-only and nonpromoting. Repeat deterministic evidence assertions without silently repeating independent model acquisition; preserve compound-command coverage and every required repeat.

Consolidate resource and supervision policy through existing processcontrol, driver and gate owners. Prove CPU work holds no GPU lease; correctness users coexist; an exclusive measurement child is never blocked by an ancestor's shared lease; publication holds only its write transaction; process/child death releases ownership. Never infer abandonment from heartbeat age or process names. Preserve physical identity across stores/worktrees, bounded waiting, cancellation causes and task-completion resource output. No second package-ownership list, wait loop, launcher or recovery state machine.

Only after these proofs, integrate implemented/checkpointed, verified and promoted transitions through the existing gate. Test refusal with outstanding checks; exact source/index/HEAD and immutable lineage; restart/replan without orphaned obligations; mandatory escalation; final full integration; elapsed-only flush with no new checkpoint; trailing obligations; exact boundaries and empty/negative/overflow/pre-origin refusal. Keep BatchFlush.Advance as the transition owner; no duplicate accumulator or reset authority. Privatize gate-only cost helpers and remove displaced callers atomically. Retain reviewed exclusions from prior lane intakes; no open lane plan or previously refused policy is implicitly imported.

Measure cold and resumed runs on the same representative change matrix, including an evidence-only E4B selection, a test change, fixture/runtime input change, kernel and gate-policy change. Report full wall, wait, acquisition, checks, publication, repeated loads, package reuse, outstanding obligations and operator interventions; do not equate summed phase time with elapsed savings. Require reduced repeated work/intervention with identical regression detection; otherwise keep the old policy. The E4B 935.2-second gate executed 234 packages with zero package reuse after a 97.1-second database-lock failure: use that incident to drive a controlled counterexample, not a universal performance threshold.

Retained open incident authorities (closure requires their own evidence): evidence:sha256:0f4b6d07607b3fa8ee6ee7f320646e5dbbd5b38b025a19c2046d54aed7fa4b4e, evidence:sha256:13a4473eab084e75be2c92ffc5bb6a8544fe78e3c6edd04abf2dd3a8c3be00db, evidence:sha256:42f5196b3d02c67f3de8e67ee22f5bcbde3e4673e6d6059e2c052900def5dfc5, evidence:sha256:5907e3a581c7ee0151f63a42454a0b576b90735054c1969518d410e07f944795.

After Hatchet intake, validation-gate-selection owns immediate call-reach, shared scope and measured adoption. Reuse its receipts and tests here; do not reimplement that work. The modality-report prerequisite applies to broad batch promotion, not to the independent selector improvements.

The first 99cdcd8d merge gate spent 1651.3 seconds before reporting a 0-second missing-dataset failure. The device runner buffered TestMultimodalTrainingMatrix's missing P2 image until all five packages finished; devicemath, diffusionimage, hybridtrain and latentimage passed. The audio worktree's declared dataset root held all four exact corpora; master's root did not. Verify configured roots and pinned dataset/model/oracle identities before scheduling expensive checks, using existing artifact and dataroot owners. Do not infer availability from another worktree or mark missing input as a skip. Four SHA-verified hard links resolved master's fixture availability; the exact failing test then passed in 17.058 seconds. Extend existing test-evidence parsing to surface failures and active tests promptly, preserve independently passed packages across a failed device group, and resume only outstanding affected checks. Freeze acceptance and test identities; do not fabricate a combined pass from unbound console output. Add this observed missing-input/partial-success case to the restart and batching acceptance matrix.

The unchanged-source merge retry reused 14 checks, then failed a browser download test that read a file before Chromium released it. The repair waits for the matching browser download-completion event on the existing DevTools transport, retains payload/cleanup assertions and bounds missing events by the test deadline. Ordinary write contention is expected; completion must follow the producer's event, not file existence or an arbitrary delay. Preserve this counterexample when changing browser test selection or evidence reuse.

verification_batch.rationale: One existing-owner process-control integration, subdivided into bounded acceptance checkpoints. Inspect existing resource and persistence owners before editing; explicitly amend scope if another owner is required. Existing bound tests remain lower bounds. New named tests below are implementation obligations, not claims that these capabilities already pass. Migrate cmd/test-lane with the shared streaming evidence contract; it is an existing consumer, not a new test runner.
verification_batch.reopen_when: Cumulative source, transitive dependencies, fixtures, resolved environment, resource identity, required acceptance or scope changes invalidate the affected evidence and reopen durable obligations. Checkpoints never complete the parent.

checkpoints.title: Prove full change coverage, including external consumers
checkpoints.verify: test -f internal/gate/change_selection_shadow_test.go && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestChangeSelectiveVerificationShadow$' -count=1 && test -f internal/gate/change_selection_required_matrix_test.go && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestChangeSelectionRequiredMatrix$' -count=1

Prove OS-held GPU ownership across worktrees and consumer lifetimes
Prove restart, time-only flush and complete cumulative promotion

items.title: Enforce cheap execution-coverage regression checks before device-wide work

steps.title: Enforce cheap execution-coverage regression checks before device-wide work
steps.rationale: Use the code/kernel manifest and typed recipe/operator facts to select a small deterministic model set covering affected weight types, operator paths, head geometry, attention/cache policy and modality; weight type alone is insufficient.
